questions.q: To the saints in which city is Ephesians addressed?
questions.evidence: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus

questions.q: By what have you been saved through faith, Paul says?
questions.evidence: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves

questions.q: How does Paul tell husbands to love their wives?
questions.evidence: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it

questions.q: What does Paul tell believers to put on, to stand against the devil?
questions.evidence: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil

questions.q: In the armor of God, what is the sword of the Spirit?
questions.evidence: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God
